evals.prompt: I'm picking up the story that adds bulk archive to the projects list. Where does that fit in the product: which screen, which roles can archive today, and what other features touch archived projects?
evals.expected_output: Loads business-feature-context, reads the map with `bun run context:map business-feature-context --section <projects feature id>` (never the raw HTML), answers from the CRUD matrix and the UI inventory with the section id and data-updated date, and points to the master design plan for how the screen looks. If the map is a placeholder it says so and hands over `project-context` mode `features`.

evals.prompt: la pantalla de facturas tiene un botón de duplicar que el mapa de features no menciona, lo agregamos al mapa?
evals.expected_output: Loads business-feature-context and follows references/refresh.md: locates the section via --list / --section, PROPOSES a one-section edit in the fixed proposal shape with the observed evidence and waits for an explicit yes before editing only that section of references/business-feature-map.html and bumping data-updated. Answers in Spanish. Touches no file outside the skill's references/.

evals.prompt: Which RLS policy hides archived projects from viewers, and is there a trigger that sets archived_at?
evals.expected_output: Should NOT be answered from business-feature-context: RLS policies and triggers belong to business-data-context (plus [DB_TOOL]). At most business-feature-context is cited for which screen offers the archive action.

evals.prompt: vamos a agregar un formulario de edición de perfil con un guard por rol, qué roles pueden editar hoy y desde qué pantalla?
evals.expected_output: Loads business-feature-context, reads the map with `bun run context:map business-feature-context --section <id>` (never the raw HTML), answers from the CRUD matrix and the UI inventory with the section id and data-updated date. evals.prompt: en qué parte del producto encaja la historia de exportar reportes? necesito saber qué otras funcionalidades toca antes de planificarla
evals.expected_output: Loads business-feature-context and places the story using the feature catalog and the cross-feature flows of the map, citing section ids. Answers in Spanish.

evals.prompt: Which endpoint group handles login and what error codes does it return?
